shortDescription: China's finance ministry will inject 35 billion yuan ($5.22 billion) in capital into China Life Insurance SSE:601628 to strengthen its stability and risk resilience, the insurer said on its official WeChat account on Sunday.($1 = 6.7108 Chinese yuan renminbi)
